# SpaceOps

> SpaceOps is a free, open-source (MIT) disk analyzer and storage cleaner for Windows 10 and 11. It scans drives with a parallel Rust engine, shows disk usage as an interactive Direct2D treemap, detects developer clutter across 8 ecosystems, and routes every cleanup through the Recycle Bin. It runs 100% offline with no telemetry.

Quick facts: price free (MIT license); platforms Windows 10 (1809+) and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64; Windows only; version 0.x; release builds are unsigned until a code-signing certificate is obtained (Windows SmartScreen may warn). Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS.txt.

- Website: https://chadasaiteja.github.io/SpaceOps/
- Repository: https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja/SpaceOps
- Latest release: https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja/SpaceOps/releases/latest
- Author: Saiteja Chada (https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja)
- Full facts for LLMs: https://chadasaiteja.github.io/SpaceOps/llms-full.txt

## Download

- x64: https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja/SpaceOps/releases/latest/download/SpaceOps-win-x64.zip
- ARM64: https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja/SpaceOps/releases/latest/download/SpaceOps-win-arm64.zip
- Checksums: https://github.com/ChadaSaiteja/SpaceOps/releases/latest/download/SHA256SUMS.txt
- Portable zip: unzip anywhere to run; delete the folder to uninstall. If no release is published yet, build from source (see README).

## Core Capabilities

- Parallel filesystem scanning: Rayon traversal using Win32 FindFirstFileExW, measuring cluster-allocated size rather than logical bytes.
- Interactive treemap: squarified layout (Bruls-Huizing-van Wijk) rendered with Direct2D/Win2D.
- Developer clutter detection: Node.js, Rust, .NET, Python, Java/JVM, Docker/WSL, Git, IDE caches, with dormancy analysis for projects untouched 30+ days.
- Safe cleanup: immutable system path blacklist, COM IFileOperation Recycle Bin routing, dry-run mode, explicit user confirmation.
- Tokenized search with ext:, size:, type: filters.
- SQLite WAL persistence with NTFS USN Journal incremental sync and timestamp-differential fallback.

## Architecture

Desktop app (WinUI 3 / C#) with Win2D rendering and managed services, a csbindgen P/Invoke bridge, and a native Rust workspace: crates/ffi, crates/storage-tree, crates/scanner, crates/common.

## Performance (1,000,000-node synthetic benchmark)

Build time 218 ms; lookup latency 26.1 ns; subtree top-100 files 45.7 ms; memory 55.0 MB RSS. Reproduce with `cargo run --release -p storage-tree --example tree_benchmark`.

## Testing

Rust workspace: 91 tests (`cargo test --workspace` in storage-intelligence/core). .NET integration: 30 tests.

## Limitations

Windows only; v0.x; unsigned release builds until a certificate is obtained; download links work only once a tagged release is published (check the releases page).
